newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin doing well, allowed to move around - doctors.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin doing well, allowed to move around - doctors.

text.p: Doctors said on Sunday that Russian President Boris Yeltsin was in "satisfactory condition" after his heart bypass operation and was being allowed to move around for limited periods, the Kremlin press service said.
A statement issued after a regular meeting of Yeltsin's medical team said his blood pressure, pulse and temperature were stable.
"The patient has been allowed to move around for two or two and a half hours a day within rooms...in the Central Clinical Hospital, including his working office," the statement said.
It said the council of doctors would meet daily in the next week.
The 65-year-old Russian leader was back on his feet on Thursday, just two days after the seven-hour quintuple bypass operation at Moscow's Cardiology Research Centre.
On Friday he was transferred to the more familiar surroundings of the Central Clinical Hospital, where he was treated after two heart attacks last year.
Yeltsin has issued several decrees and statements from his hospital bed but has yet to appear on television following his operation.
